entities.summary: Grigory Yefimovich Grum-Grshimailo was a Russian zoologist best known for his expeditions to Central Asia, western Mongolia and Tuva, and the Russian Far East. In literature his name is sometimes spelled as Grigor Efimowitsch Grumm-Grzhimailo or Grigory Yefimovich Grumm-Grzhimaylo.
